what_differs: On 2026-08-04 Kobi proposed dropping the email lookup and relying on the CMS external ID, and said an SLC without a player ID is flagged for Ops review (Emily agreed). The WAGR-5 comment of 2026-08-10 keeps email/secondary-email fallback when the external ID does not match, and WAGR-40 assumes the CMS owns de-duplication, which WagerTech said it still had to resolve.
suggested_action: Confirm with WagerTech who owns player ID and de-duplication, then record the final matching rule (external ID only vs email fallback, and handling of a blank player ID) on WAGR-5 and WAGR-40.
